en.headline: CHP investigates two new Mpox cases; annual total reaches 23
en.dek: Two men, aged 48 and 30, are in stable condition under isolation after testing positive; both reported high-risk contact with other men in Hong Kong during the incubation period.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Wednesday that it is investigating two confirmed Mpox cases. Both patients are receiving isolation treatment in hospital and are in stable condition.

The first case involves a 48-year-old man who developed lip ulcers on 8 September, followed by fever and swollen neck lymph nodes. He attended a social hygiene clinic on 11 September and was referred to Princess Margaret Hospital, where rashes were found on his hands, forearms and upper back.

The second case involves a 30-year-old man who developed fever, sore throat and rashes on various parts of the body, including genital areas, on 7 September. He sought medical attention at a private clinic and a public hospital accident and emergency department before attending a social hygiene clinic on 16 September.

Laboratory testing confirmed the monkeypox virus in both cases. The Centre said the two patients had high-risk contact with other men in Hong Kong during the incubation period. No epidemiological links have been identified between the two cases or with earlier confirmed cases.

As of Wednesday, Hong Kong has recorded 23 Mpox cases this year, including 18 local and five imported. Fourteen of the cases were reported since August. The Centre urged people with high-risk contact to seek medical attention if symptoms appear and reminded high-risk groups that free Mpox vaccination is available at social hygiene clinics.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查兩宗猴痘確診個案 本年累計23宗
zh.dek: 兩名分別48歲及30歲男子情況穩定，正接受隔離治療；兩人潛伏期內均曾在港與其他男子有高風險接觸。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周三表示，正調查兩宗猴痘確診個案。兩名患者目前在醫院接受隔離治療，情況穩定。
首宗個案涉及一名48歲男子，他自9月8日起出現嘴唇潰瘍，其後發燒及頸部淋巴結腫大。他於9月11日到社會衞生科診所求診，同日被轉介至瑪嘉烈醫院，入院後發現手掌、前臂及上背有皮疹。
第二宗個案涉及一名30歲男子，他於9月7日出現發燒、喉嚨痛及身體多處皮疹（包括生殖器官附近、口腔、頸項及手指）。他曾到私家診所及公立醫院急症室求診，因徵狀持續，於9月16日到社會衞生科診所求診。
兩人的臨床樣本經化驗後證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性。中心表示，兩人於潛伏期內曾在香港與其他男子有高風險接觸，暫時沒有資料顯示兩宗個案之間或與早前其他個案有流行病學關連。
截至周三，本年累計錄得23宗猴痘個案，包括18宗本地個案及5宗輸入個案，其中14宗為8月以來新增。中心呼籲有高風險接觸人士如出現相關徵狀應盡快求醫，並提醒高風險群組可到社會衞生科診所免費接種猴痘疫苗。
